about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the cozy atmosphere of puzzles and waifu aesthetics with the game Waifu Slumber Party! This is a unique game for puzzle lovers and anime girls, where you will have a relaxing night full of charm, pillows and a warm atmosphere.

Game features:

  • 30 levels with unique puzzles

    Each level opens a new illustration with attractive anime girls in a pajama theme. Collect the picture piece by piece to see all the details of their appearance, poses and mood. The difficulty increases as you progress - the game is suitable for both beginners and experienced puzzle fans.

  • Gallery of completed puzzles

    All completed images are saved in a special gallery, where you can review your favorite illustrations at any time. It becomes a personal collection of warm and intimate moments with your waifus.

  • Achievement system

    Get rewards for your successes - for completing levels, progress, and special actions. Achievements motivate and make the process even more enjoyable.

  • Convenient controls

    Simple and clear interface: drag puzzle pieces into place and enjoy the meditative process of assembly.

  • Intimate night atmosphere and waifu style

    Soft lighting, cozy interiors, and cute girls in pajamas create a relaxing and romantic atmosphere. Each waifu has her own character, which makes each puzzle special.

Who is this game for?

Waifu Slumber Party is a great choice for anyone who loves anime and wants to immerse themselves in an atmosphere of calm and comfort. Suitable for those looking for a relaxing evening activity or for those looking to collect a full collection of anime girls.

Complete puzzles, unlock achievements, and enjoy your own waifu party in Waifu Slumber Party!
